clips.title: The story
paras: At the Mor'shan Rampart, Kadrak guards the northern frontier between the Barrens and Ashenvale. He directs dispatches and reinforcements into the contested forest, where the Horde fights the night elves.

At the Mor'shan Rampart, Kadrak guards the main route between the Barrens and Ashenvale. The barricade marks a hard border: Horde-held plains lie to the south, and night elf-guarded woods stretch north. Kadrak keeps watch against Sentinels and hostile woodland creatures, holding the perimeter against incursions.

Kadrak also handles military reports between the Barrens and logging camps deeper in Ashenvale. Couriers bring him combat reports from the Warsong Outriders, and he directs supplies and reinforcements to outposts such as Splintertree Post. Those who report to Kadrak are sent onward into the struggle for the forest.
